title: Deductible Not Met Flow
description: Verify claim auto-pends to Deductible Review queue when deductible is not met
precondition: Member is enrolled. OON deductible balance is $1000.
test_step_description: Submit out-of-network outpatient diagnostic claim for processing.
test_step_expected_result: Claim is blocked from direct adjudication, status transitions to 'Auto-Pend', and the record routes to 'Deductible Review' queue.

title: Edge - Exact Deductible Balance
description: Verify allocation logic when claim amount exactly matches outstanding deductible
precondition: Member OON deductible balance is exactly $150.
test_step_description: Submit claim matching deductible balance exactly.
test_step_expected_result: System applies full $150 to deductible; plan covers $0, member responsibility is $150, new deductible balance updates to $0.

title: Negative - Missing Diagnostic Code
description: Verify validation layer flags claims missing mandatory diagnostic fields
test_step_description: Attempt to ingest claim without diagnosis descriptors.
test_step_expected_result: Ingestion drops out with validation error alert mapping code 'ERR-VAL-99' (Missing Mandatory Diagnosis Data).

title: Deductible Partial Match
description: Verify partial deductible application when claim amount exceeds remaining deductible balance
test_step_description: Process out-of-network claim through the adjudication engine.
test_step_expected_result: System applies $200 to satisfy remaining deductible, then subjects the remaining $300 to standard 30% coinsurance ($90 member responsibility).
